target.value: up to three undead creatures, within 30 ft. of each other

description.summary: This spell renders as many as three undead creatures held as the hold spell
description.value: This spell renders as many as three undead creatures held as the hold spell. A non-intelligent undead creature gets no saving throw; an intelligent undead creature does. If the spell is successful, it renders the undead creature held as the hold spell for the duration of the spell. The effect is broken if the halted creatures are attacked or take damage.
